scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/runtime-model && npm run build -w packages/gadget-engine && npm run build -w packages/chain-engine && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/runtime-model && npm run test -w packages/gadget-engine && npm run test -w packages/chain-engine && npm run test -w apps/api
